description: Northgate Credit Union runs the same MERIDIAN Core 7.2.1 product as the base recording, configured with their own field labels and column headings. Four patches; the rest of the flow is inherited, so a fix to the base reaches Northgate without re-recording.

patches.reason: Northgate's account grid heads the balance column 'BALANCE'.

renames.reason: Northgate labels the inquiry submit button 'Find'. This touches both the click step and the postcondition that waits for it.
